= callout-guards(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-06
:manmanual: Callout checks
:mansource: acdc

== Name
callout-guards - preserve callout spacing and literal blocks

== Synopsis

[source,rust]
----
G01 code // <1>
G02 code # <2>
G03 code ;; <3>
G04 code -- <4>
G05 code //  <5>
G06 code//<6><7>
G07 code  // <8>
// <9>

  // <10>
G08 code //	<11>
G09 code // \<12>
G10 code // <13> suffix
----
<1> Slash prefix.
<2> Hash prefix in Rust.
<3> Semicolon prefix in Rust.
<4> Dash prefix in Rust.
<5> Two spaces retain the prefix.
<6> No added space.
<7> Adjacent marker.
<8> Two authored spaces before the prefix.
<9> Guard-only line stays separate.
<10> Indentation and the preceding blank line stay.
<11> A tab does not belong to the prefix.

[source,xml]
----
G11 <tag/> <!--1--><!--2-->
G12 <tag/><!--3--> <!--4-->
G13 <tag/> <!-- ordinary --> <!--5-->
G14 <tag/> <!--6--> suffix
G15 <tag/> \<!--7-->
----
<1> XML marker.
<2> Adjacent XML marker.
<3> No added space before XML marker.
<4> Authored space between markers.
<5> Ordinary comments stay.

[source,erlang,line-comment=%]
----
G16 code % <1>
G17 code # <2>
----
<1> Custom prefix.
<2> Custom prefix replaces the defaults.

[source,rust,line-comment=]
----
G18 code // <1>
----
<1> Empty prefix disables stripping.

[source,text,line-comment="※"]
----
G19 café ※ <.>
G20 café ※<.>
----
<.> Unicode custom prefix.
<.> Automatic numbering.

....
G21 literal // <1>
G22 literal <!--2-->
G23 literal<3><3>
....
<1> Literal slash prefix.
<2> Literal XML marker.
<3> Repeated literal marker.

[literal,line-comment=%]
G24 paragraph % <1>
G25 paragraph # <2>

<1> Literal paragraph custom prefix.
<2> Default prefix stays.

//-

[literal]
G26 literal paragraph # <1>
G27 literal paragraph <!--2-->

<1> Literal paragraph common prefix.
<2> Literal paragraph XML marker.

//-

[listing,line-comment=]
G28 listing -- <1>

<1> Listing paragraph with empty prefix.

//-

[source,rust]
G29 source # <1>

<1> Source paragraph uses all default prefixes.

:icons: font

....
G30 font # <1>
....
<1> Icons do not alter manpage callout rendering.

:icons!:

----
G31 plain # <1>
----
<1> Body unsets retain manpage callout rendering.
